    36	def load_dataset(path: str = "materials_thermal_dataset.csv") -> pd.DataFrame:
    37	    """Load complete Phase 1 dataset (features + targets + identifiers)."""
    38	    if not os.path.exists(path):
    39	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Dataset not found: {os.path.abspath(path)}. Run Phase 1 first.")
    40	    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    41	    print(f"[Phase 2] Loaded dataset: {len(df)} rows x {len(df.columns)} cols from {path}")
    42	    return df

    45	def split_features_targets(df: pd.DataFrame, targets: list = TARGETS) -> tuple:
    46	    """Separate feature matrix X and multi-target y from complete dataset."""
    47	    exclude = targets + ["material_id", "formula_pretty"]
    48	    feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in exclude]
    49	    X = df[feature_cols].copy()
    50	    y = df[targets].copy()
    51	    print(f"[Phase 2] Split: X={X.shape}, y={y.shape}, feature_cols={len(feature_cols)}")
    52	    return X, y

    55	def build_model(name: str = "random_forest", multi_output: bool = True) -> Pipeline:
    56	    """Build a clean sklearn Pipeline with scaler and regressor.
    57	    If multi_output=True, wraps regressor in MultiOutputRegressor for joint prediction."""
    58	    if name == "random_forest":
    59	        reg = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
    60	    elif name == "gradient_boosting":
    61	        reg = GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=42)
    62	    elif name == "ridge":
    63	        reg = RidgeCV(alphas=[0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0])
    64	    else:
    65	        reg = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
    66	    if multi_output:
    67	        reg = MultiOutputRegressor(reg, n_jobs=-1)
    68	    pipe = Pipeline([
    69	        ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    70	        ("regressor", reg),
    71	    ])
    72	    return pipe
    73

    75	def train_predict(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.DataFrame, target_name: str = None, multi_target: bool = False) -> dict:
    76	    """Train predictor with 80/20 split. Supports single-target (target_name) or multi-output (multi_target=True with full y DataFrame)."""
    77	    model = build_model("random_forest", multi_output=multi_target)
    78	    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    79	        X, y if multi_target else y[target_name], test_size=0.20, random_state=42
    80	    )
    81	    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    82	    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    83	    metrics = {
    84	        "target": target_name if target_name else "multi_output",
    85	        "r2": float(r2_score(y_test, y_pred, multioutput="uniform_average")) if multi_target else float(r2_score(y_test, y_pred)),
    86	        "mae": float(mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred, multioutput="uniform_average")) if multi_target else float(mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)),
    87	        "rmse": float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred, multioutput="uniform_average"))) if multi_target else float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred))),
    88	        "n_train": len(X_train),
    89	        "n_test": len(X_test),
    90	        "n_features": X.shape[1],
    91	    }
    92	    print(f"[Phase 2] {target_name} -> R2={metrics['r2']:.3f}, MAE={metrics['mae']:.3f}, RMSE={metrics['rmse']:.3f}")
    93	    return {"model": model, "metrics": metrics, "X_train": X_train, "X_test": X_test,
    94	            "y_train": y_train, "y_test": y_test, "y_pred": y_pred}

    97	def evaluate_model(X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, model, feature_names) -> dict:
    98	    """Evaluate fitted model on test set; return per-target MAE/R2 and top-10 feature importances."""
    99	    from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, mean_absolute_error
   100	    metrics = {}
   101	    importances = {}
   102	    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
   103	    # For single-output or multi-output, determine per-target results
   104	    # If y_test is 2D and y_pred is 2D -> multi-output; compute independently per column
   105	    if hasattr(y_test, "shape") and len(y_test.shape) > 1 and y_pred.shape[1] == y_test.shape[1]:
   106	        target_names = TARGETS
   107	        for i, target in enumerate(target_names):
   108	            metrics[target] = {
   109	                "MAE": float(mean_absolute_error(y_test.iloc[:, i], y_pred[:, i])),
   110	                "R2": float(r2_score(y_test.iloc[:, i], y_pred[:, i])),
   111	            }
   112	        # Aggregate feature importances across estimators (mean for multi-output)
   113	        # RandomForest/MultiOutputRegressor: access estimators_
   114	        reg = model.named_steps.get("regressor", model)
   115	        if hasattr(reg, "estimators_"):
   116	            # MultiOutputRegressor: average importances across estimators
   117	            avg_importances = np.zeros(X_train.shape[1])
   118	            for est in reg.estimators_:
   119	                if hasattr(est, "feature_importances_"):
   120	                    avg_importances += est.feature_importances_
   121	            avg_importances /= len(reg.estimators_)
   122	        else:
   123	            avg_importances = reg.feature_importances_
   124	        importances = dict(zip(feature_names, avg_importances))
   125	    else:
   126	        target_name = TARGETS[0] if y_test.ndim == 1 else TARGETS[0]
   127	        metrics[target_name] = {
   128	            "MAE": float(mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)),
   129	            "R2": float(r2_score(y_test, y_pred)),
   130	        }
   131	        reg = model.named_steps.get("regressor", model)
   132	        importances = dict(zip(feature_names, reg.feature_importances_))
   133	    # Print per-target MAE and R2
   134	    print("\n=== Per-Target Evaluation (Test Set) ===")
   135	    for name, m in metrics.items():
   136	        print(f"  {name}: MAE = {m['MAE']:.4f}, R2 = {m['R2']:.4f}")
   137	    # Top 10 features by importance
   138	    top10 = sorted(importances.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]
   139	    print("\n=== Top 10 Most Heavily Weighted Physical Features ===")
   140	    for rank, (feat, imp) in enumerate(top10, 1):
   141	        print(f"  {rank:2d}. {feat}  (importance = {imp:.5f})")
   142	    return {"metrics": metrics, "feature_importances": importances, "top_10": top10}

   145	def run_phase2_pipeline(
   146	    dataset_path: str = "materials_thermal_dataset.csv",
   147	    output_dir: str = "outputs",
   148	) -> dict:
   149	    """End-to-end Phase 2 training and evaluation pipeline."""
   150	    try:
   151	        print("[Phase 2] Starting ML Predictor pipeline...")
   152	        df = load_dataset(dataset_path)
   153	        X, y = split_features_targets(df)
   154	        # Train a separate model for each target
   155	        results = {}
   156	        for target in TARGETS:
   157	            results[target] = train_predict(X, y, target)
   158	        # Cross-validated score across all targets (mean R2)
   159	        cv_scores = {}
   160	        for target in TARGETS:
   161	            model_cv = build_model("random_forest", multi_output=False)
   162	            scores = cross_val_score(model_cv, X, y[target], cv=KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), scoring="r2")
   163	            cv_scores[target] = float(np.mean(scores))
   164	            print(f"[Phase 2] CV R2 (5-fold) for {target}: {cv_scores[target]:.3f}")
   165	        # Aggregate result
   166	        output = {
   167	            "dataset_path": os.path.abspath(dataset_path),
   168	            "feature_count": X.shape[1],
   169	            "record_count": len(X),
   170	            "targets": TARGETS,
   171	            "results": {t: results[t]["metrics"] for t in TARGETS},
   172	            "cv_scores": cv_scores,
   173	        }
   174	        # Evaluate multi-output model and print top features
   175	        feature_names = [c for c in df.columns if c not in TARGETS + ["material_id", "formula_pretty"]]
   176	        multi_model = build_model("random_forest", multi_output=True)
   177	        multi_model.fit(X, y)
   178	        # Use the split from the last single-target result for consistent test evaluation
   179	        last_train = results[TARGETS[-1]]["X_train"]
   180	        last_test = results[TARGETS[-1]]["X_test"]
   181	        # Recompute y_train/y_test aligned with same split for multi-output
   182	        _, y_train_m = train_test_split(X.index if False else y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42)
   183	        # Simpler approach: just split the same way using the same seed
   184	        _, X_multi_test, _, y_multi_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42)
   185	        eval_result = evaluate_model(X_train=X, X_test=X_multi_test, y_train=y, y_test=y_multi_test, model=multi_model, feature_names=feature_names)
   186	        output["evaluation"] = eval_result["metrics"]
   187	        output["top_10_features"] = eval_result["top_10"]
   188	        # Export fitted multi-output pipeline (scaler + model weights) for generative loop
   189	        model_path = "materials_predictor_model.joblib"
   190	        joblib.dump(multi_model, model_path)
   191	        output["exported_model_path"] = os.path.abspath(model_path)
   192	        output["exported_model_size_bytes"] = os.path.getsize(model_path) if os.path.exists(model_path) else None
   193	        print(f"[Phase 2] Exported fitted pipeline to: {os.path.abspath(model_path)}")
   194	        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
   195	        print(f"[Phase 2] Pipeline complete. Outputs saved to: {os.path.abspath(output_dir)}")
   196	        return output
   197	    except Exception as exc:
   198	        print(f"[Phase 2] ERROR in run_phase2_pipeline: {exc}")
